name: Johaan's Special Drink
summary: At Brill, Apothecary Johaan offers a drink that tests the Royal Apothecary Society’s developing plague. Its deadly purpose hides behind the look of an ordinary refreshment.

sections.title: A Toxic Brew
sections.body: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan mixes venomous components with local reagents. The brew looks like a tavern drink, but it tests how virulent the plague is against living beings. Johaan offers it as though to quench a captive’s thirst. The work helps the Forsaken apothecaries create a weapon potent enough to fulfill Sylvanas Windrunner’s designs for Azeroth.

sections.title: The Cellar Trial
sections.body: Beneath the Gallows' End Tavern, the Deathguard keeps stray intruders in a cellar holding cell. A captured dwarven mountaineer is chained there. Mistaking the brew for crude ale, he drinks eagerly, then dies at once. His death shows the Royal Apothecary Society that its latest strain can swiftly extinguish living victims.

faq.answer: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan prepares a deadly drink to test the Forsaken’s developing plague against living beings.

faq.q: Who is the drink given to?
aliases: who do i give the drink to
faq.answer: The drink is taken to the cellar beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill and given to a captured mountaineer held by the local Deathguard.

faq.q: What happens when someone drinks it?
faq.answer: The prisoner drinks the brew, expecting harsh ale, and dies at once.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan make this drink?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan makes the drink to test the Royal Apothecary Society’s new plague. He gives it to a captured dwarf to see how effectively it kills mortal life.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help the Royal Apothecary Society and advance Lady Sylvanas’s designs against the living.
As a dwarf, you face the danger of capture by the Deathguard near Tirisfal Glades and being used as a test subject.
